title: Three Seasons and One Short Fence
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：wolf　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 wolf 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1990 the keeper ① hunted the wolf that no child in the zoo would have recorded, and he said the hunting was the whole of the season. The ② wolf, meaning the animal itself and not the fence, ran three seasons and stayed unrecorded in the book; a wolf, he said, is the only thing in a zoo that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ wolf in that zoo had the same short fence beside it, and the ④ wolf at the far shed, meaning the calf they kept for the children to feed and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A wolf, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the keeper said the recording is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the wolf was the whole of the matter, meaning the greed and not the animal. The ⑥ wolf, meaning the greed and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; wolf, he said, is either something you hunt or the only word that means both an animal and a greed. He said the greed is the part they remember.

By 1995 the ⑦ wolf had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short fence. The ⑧ wolf of the whole thing, the keeper wrote in March, was one zoo and three seasons of recording; wolf, he said, is either the calf at the far shed or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ wolf I remember is the animal recorded in the register, which closed in 1997 and is still recorded as the quietest in the zoo. A ⑩ wolf, my mother said in 1999, is the only animal that improves by being recorded; every wolf, she said, is a greed that has agreed to look like an animal. She said the greed was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 狼（指兽舍里每一只旁边的那一只）
B. n. 狼（指那只狼本身，与矮矮的围栏相对）
C. 固定搭配：hunt the wolf 猎这一只狼
D. n. 狼（指留给孩子们喂的那一头）
E. n. 狼之事（抽象总称，指一处兽舍的狼之事）
F. n. 狼（指饲养台账里写到、被记载的那一只）
G. n. 狼、贪婪（指一件事里人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 贪婪（抽象总称，指人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: hunted the wolf that no child in the zoo would have recorded
The wolf, meaning the animal itself and not the fence
the wolf at the far shed
the wolf was the whole of the matter
the wolf had become a line in a register
The wolf of the whole thing
A wolf, my mother said in 1999

answers.why: hunt the wolf 意为“猎这一只狼”，1990 年那位饲养员把兽舍里没有一位孩子肯记载的一只狼做了一遍。
wolf 意为“狼”，指那只狼本身而不是矮矮的围栏，它经过了三个季度而在簿子上没有被记载。
wolf 意为“狼”，指兽舍里每一只旁边的那一只，每一只旁边都有同一道矮矮的围栏。
wolf 意为“狼”，指最远那间棚舍的留给孩子们喂的那一头，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
wolf 意为“狼、贪婪”，指一件事里人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这只贪婪就是那件事的全部。
wolf 意为“贪婪”，指人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西而不是那只狼，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
wolf 意为“狼”，指饲养台账里写到、被记载的那一只，到 1995 年这一只成了饲养台账里的一行。
wolf 意为“狼之事”，饲养员三月写道，整件事的狼之事是一处兽舍和三个季度的记载。
wolf 意为“狼”，我记得的是饲养台账里记载过的那一只，1997 年养大了，至今仍被说成兽舍里最安静的一只。
wolf 为抽象总称，母亲 1999 年说，狼是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的狼。
